{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Algonquin HubLine''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov/czm/moris/metadata/moris_algonquin_hubline_lng_arc.htm|title=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|website=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Beverly, Massachusetts to Weymouth, Massachusetts.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov/czm/moris/metadata/moris_algonquin_hubline_lng_arc.htm|title=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|website=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Algonquin Gas Transmission LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17253586/algonquin-mnp-file-pipeline-applications|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''29.5 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov/czm/moris/metadata/moris_algonquin_hubline_lng_arc.htm|title=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|website=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/general-interest/companies/article/17253586/algonquin-mnp-file-pipeline-applications|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov/czm/moris/metadata/moris_algonquin_hubline_lng_arc.htm|title=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|website=maps.massgis.digital.mass.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
